alpaca_position_disconnects.error_message: Failed to get all positions: ('Connection aborted.', RemoteDisconnected('Remote end closed connection without response'))
alpaca_position_disconnects.impact: Each occurrence causes the tick to fail or timeout. Scheduler recovers on next tick.
alpaca_position_disconnects.root_cause: Alpaca paper API drops HTTP connections intermittently. The SDK's connection is not pooled or retried.
alpaca_position_disconnects.recommendation: Add retry with exponential backoff in positions_service.get_all_positions(). Consider caching positions for 1-2 ticks.

scheduler_timeouts.impact: Tick streak=1 both times, recovered immediately. No trades were pending so no damage.
scheduler_timeouts.root_cause: Position fetch hangs past asyncio timeout deadline due to Alpaca disconnect
scheduler_timeouts.recommendation: Same as above — retry logic in positions_service

websocket_disconnects.impact: Brief data gaps, auto-reconnected. Stale data warnings follow.
websocket_disconnects.recommendation: No action needed — reconnection logic works correctly

stale_data_warnings.note: Occur during pre-market hours and after WebSocket reconnections. Expected behavior.

regime_anomaly.finding: Regime detector reported 'trending_up' for 65 out of 73 visible ticks while SPY fell -1.52%
regime_anomaly.impact: Inverse ETF regime-flip logic cannot activate if regime is wrong. Trending-down block only activated briefly.
possible_causes: Regime lookback window may be too long (multi-day trend overrides intraday sell-off)
Regime uses features that don't reflect same-day price action
The regime model may use a different timeframe than the 5-min bars
regime_anomaly.recommendation: Investigate regime detection input features and lookback. This is the highest-priority investigation item.

entries_blocked_analysis.note: Nearly half of visible ticks never even reach candidate evaluation. This may include pre-market, post-close, and warmup ticks — needs investigation to confirm.
